dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .

RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gdb && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

CMD ["python", "your_script.py"]
explanation:
1. requirements.txt includes 'gdb' (GNU Debugger) and 'msgpack' (MessagePack serialization library) as detected imports.
2. Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim as base image.
3. Installs system dependencies (gdb) via apt-get since it's not a Python package.
4. Installs Python packages from requirements.txt.
5. Note: Replace 'your_script.py' with your actual entry point script.
